cause_quote: The commit added `requireLoadedCommand: true` to update service inspection and changed the systemd lookup to `opts?.requireLoaded && !inspection ? "GetUnit" : "LoadUnit"`, so an inspection without a manager binding could no longer reload a collected unit.
user_saw: A Linux update could stop at `managed-service-preflight` after systemd collected the stopped Gateway unit.
summary: The fix uses the installed updater’s effective UID to re-inspect a collected systemd unit when a verified legacy handoff records a stopped service and omits the manager UID.
reasoning: The parent already revalidated stopped handoffs and used `LoadUnit`, which could reload an installed unit after systemd collected it. #140339 switched the update inspection to `GetUnit` unless it had a manager binding, and #143859 later accepted a missing UID only at the identity comparison after inspection. The historical diffs establish the lookup change, while the reported release-validation run covers the later candidate path.
